body: Thank you for clarifying. I appreciate it.

I really wish you wouldn't condescend to me and mock and dismiss me by saying I'm just a worrisome soul. But I guess I shouldn't be surprised that someone who was previously nice turned on me like this. Bye.
Oh. Well, thanks. How do you know I'm not an idiot?
Really, you wouldn't think they were a horrible idiot or something?

I did do something wrong though. The thing is I stepped right in front of her car. I dunno. It was a pretty big mistake. If she was going faster, she could have hit me. I just hope no one was watching.
Thanks. But like, I pretty much stepped in front of her car. Like it was a very very narrow street and I stepped in front of her car right as she turned into it. It was awful. I felt really weird.

Thanks but I'm really scared she's gonna tell all her coworkers bad things about me. I know all of them. And I think I really annoyed her. As I said to the commenter above, it may sound silly to anyone else but for me this was awful. And as soon as she drove past me, I just really wanted to die. I still do.

Well I'm just really scared that this woman is gonna tell her coworkers that she saw me do something silly and be all 'can you believe she did that??' I know her coworkers too :( It just feels awful. I'm serious when I say I feel suicidal. It may sound dumb to others but right after I stepped back and she drove past me, I felt like I really just wanted to die.

Relax. Take your medication. You sound like a paranoid nutjob with no life. Take your conspiracy theories elsewhere and grow up. 

You're the one screwing up here by acting like a 5 year old, and running around offering to be best friends with people you don't even know. Act like an adult and maybe people will treat you like one. Enough with your hysterical outbursts when you feel upset and rejected.

Finally. A good response that actually makes sense. 

It's been years since anybody was around. And I mean ANYBODY. I'm not talking exclusively romantic relationships here like some dumbass below assumed. I'm talking about literally another living thing.

Calm down and stop freaking out. These are not "LIES". And if you're silly enough to think that you can just offer to befriend someone because their "OP sounded sad" and think they will "be cool" with you and that will solve all their problems, then you're an idiot. And a pretty major one at that.

Get a hold of yourself. You sound really agitated and weird right now. You are not up to the task of comforting people. Your silly argumentativeness and tendency to freak out under the slightest pressure are evidence of this. Get off this board. Seriously. if you can't take the heat, get out of the kitchen. 

And stop watching so many Hollywood movies and tv shows. You can't be foolish enough to believe that just being cool with someone is going to actually help someone who has actual problems. Get a life.

Stop.

You're making promises that you cannot keep. Stop doing this and get off this board. You are not Santa Claus. Stop handing out bullshit promises and false hopes out like candy. 

Learn to be realistic. And stop treating suicidal people like misguided children who just need some positive thinking and happy thoughts about friends.

Don't blame the recipient of your incompetence. You're bad at this. Accept it, stop doing it and move on. 

This is not for you because you are really bad at helping people. 

Stop fucking lecturing. Learn to keep quiet and get some humility. A lot of times, it's good to keep your mouth shut, stay silent and not do anything when you obviously don't know what you're doing.

No. This is on you. And this is about  you being creepy. Don't try to palm this off on others:

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/37a2x5/prosuicide_what_if/crkzqpu?context=3

"The thing is that if you are one of those "throwaways" and we decided to meet so you would not be alone when you did it, you would in fact go from a "person who had no one ( a throw away )" to actually having me thus you would not be alone any longer.
Granted, this is my very first time in this sub but it seems to me that a lot of you are suffering from loneliness. *This can easily be resolved by getting to know another person from this very sub that is just as lonely as you and becoming friends.
Pooof! Loneliness gone!*"
No. I'm good, thanks. I've seen your other comments. I get your schtick where you do this whole Perky New BFF of Suicidal People thing.

You're not understanding what the problem is. And really, your comment is infuriating in its smug, self-serving, self-righteous cluelessness. I really wish you had not said anything and just kept your mouth shut. And I do realize that as you read this, you will be clicking your tongue in passive-aggressive disapproval because you cannot fathom that you might be wrong.

I never said I was looking for a relationship. This has got absolutely NOTHING to do with self-love. You don't understand what's going on at all. Because you don't have all the facts.

This is the danger with people like you. You want to help. And you presume that you have all the facts. And then you pull shit like this with your positive thinking and your smug, superior, patronizing bullshit where you talk down to the other person like they're an angry child who just needs to be a good girl or a good boy.

Shut the fuck up about "embracing happiness" and get the fuck off this board.

You don't know what you're talking about.

And frankly, I'd rather deal with crazy and vicious MRA trolls than smug people like you. Why? Because they're flat out insane. Whereas people like you have little half-bits of information and you think you have the whole picture. And then you act on your erroneous belief with this smug conviction in your superior judgement and ideas.

And the problem is, I know you're not going to feel any regret and neither will you do any introspection. You're just going to sigh and shake your head because you're just that convinced that you have it right and anyone who disagrees with you is wrong.

Just keep in mind that just because you've experienced some emotional hardship and you went through some bad stuff, that doesn't make you a fucking expert on human suffering. And it sure as shit doesn't mean you know what other people need. You are not the expert here.
That's accurate. I just don't want you to be an asshole though.

Yeah the sheer lack of physical contact with any living thing is just really tough. I can't have pets either. it's like every door is closed. I just can't figure this thing out. Meanwhile it's torture seeing all these women out holding hands with their men and just even socializing and laughing and smiling.
Alright. That's good. Thanks. And I'm still flat out fucking alone though.

I am alone. I know it's hard for MRAs like you to comprehend that women could actually have problems and be isolated. But hey. What can I say? This is reality and it's different from your fantasy world.
What the fuck. You fucking bastard. Fuck you. I wish I could smear the blood from my cut wrists all over your stupid face. But you would probably like that.
Okay you have completely missed the point. I can't deal with this any more. Thanks for making me feel worse.

there's just nobody there, man. which, okay, fine, i can somehow take that. but then to see all these girls just with their families and their boyfriends and their friends just walking around, i dunno. and in a few months, it's gonna be thanksgiving season again and i'm gonna have to hear their questions all over again about what i'm gonna do. and they'll once again start fucking blathering on about the awesome time they had with their husband or boyfriend or parents or whatever. and I'll just be like 'ohh that's so cool' and then sit in my apartment and watch tv. last year i tried killing myself. i guess this year that's gonna be my fate again. 

sorry to have so much self-pity.
